inventory.metaDescription: Digital twins for network-wide predictions, fully automated real-time transport operations and traffic management.

headings.text: Aimsun Live is a digital twin for real-time traffic management.

It uses live and historical data to simulate and monitor a network and provide on-the-spot forecasts of upcoming traffic conditions. Traffic management centres use these predictions to preempt potential problems and take action to stop cong
Aimsun Live can be applied in the following use cases:
Inform road users in real time
Predict what’s coming: Near-term forecasts for proactive traffic management.
Compare response plans: Rank interventions by your chosen KPIs.
See the whole network: Fill data gaps and extend visibility beyond detectors.
Connect with your systems: Integrate with signals, control rooms and live data feeds.
Automate operations: Run 24/7 with human-in-the-loop or full automation.
Scale with confidence: Support corridor, city or region-scale operations.
To learn more, send us a message and we'll start the conversation.
